note: Pins by number; what each function means, its supply and default net class. SOT-23-5 numbering from Table 3-1; the KiCad symbol Battery_Management:MCP73831-2-OT has the same numbers and names (checked pin by pin).

draw_a.when: ISS while charging, VDD = VREG(typ) + 1 V to 6 V, TA -40 to 85 C: the chip's own draw, on top of the charge current

power.note: Recommended range: [VREG(typical) + 0.3 V] to 6 V, i.e. 4.5-6 V for the 4.20 V -2 option (§3.1 p.11). The DC table's supply voltage is 3.75-6 V (p.3), but its limits all hold from VREG(typ) + 1 V = 5.2 V. Other ISS figures (p.3): 53 uA typ / 200 uA max at charge complete or with no battery, 25 / 50 uA with PROG floating

citation.locator: §3.1 p.11; DC Characteristics, Supply Input p.3

VDD.note: Charger input (USB VBUS). Operating 3.75-6 V, recommended VREG+0.3 V to 6 V, absolute maximum 7.0 V; bypass to VSS with at least 4.7 uF

power.note: MCP73831T-2ACI-OT, 4.20 V. v_out is VREG's min-max for the -2 option at TA -5 to 55 C (p.3). i_max_a is the fast-charge current this circuit programs: IREG = 1000 V / RPROG (§5.1.2 p.15) with the package circuit's RPROG of 4.7 kohm = 1000 / 4.7 = 212.8 mA; the datasheet's IREG spread is 90-110 mA at 10 kohm and 450-550 mA at 2 kohm (p.3), so about +/-10 %, up to some 234 mA. Below regulation it is a pass transistor: RDSON 350 mOhm typical at VDD = 3.75 V, TJ = 105 C, no maximum given (p.4); it stops altogether below the UVLO stop threshold VSTOP, 3.2-3.5 V (3.5 V max taken, p.3), and in automatic power-down when VDD < VBAT + 50 mV typ (p.4). No separate iq_a: the chip's draw is on VDD. Charging is disabled with PROG floating or RPROG >= 200 kohm (p.4, §5.1.2 p.15), so there is no enable pin; the circuit's RPROG keeps it on. theta_ja is the SOT-23-5 on a 4-layer JC51-7 board, typical (p.5); tj_max the operating junction range's top (p.5); thermal shutdown is at 150 C typ (p.5)

citation.locator: DC Characteristics pp.3-5; Temperature Specifications p.5; §5.1.2 p.15

VBAT.note: Battery charge output: drain of the internal P-channel pass transistor, to the cell's positive terminal. Regulates to 4.20 V +/-0.75 % (MCP7383X-2); bypass to VSS with at least 4.7 uF

VSS.note: 0 V reference; connect to the battery's negative terminal and the input supply's return

STAT.note: Tri-state charge status: L while preconditioning/fast/CV charging, H at charge complete, Hi-Z in shutdown or with no battery. Sinks up to 25 mA, sources up to 35 mA; VOH is VDD-0.4 V typ, so its high level is the USB supply, not 3.3 V

levels.note: supply is VDD, the charger's input: its high follows the USB supply. VOH is typical, at the sourcing current Table 5-1 gives

PROG.note: Charge current set: RPROG to VSS, IREG(mA) = 1000 V / RPROG(kohm), 2-67 kohm. Floating (or >= 200 kohm, or a logic high) disables the charger

stat.note: L while charging, H at charge complete, Hi-Z in shutdown or with no battery. Its high is VDD (the charger's input, up to 6 V), not a 3.3 V logic level
